UI Elements.Name: Page.General.Subtitle
Text: PURGE: <color=#D58D7C>LAST 2 DAYS OF WIPE</color> — SERVERWIDE FAFO

UI Elements.Name: Page.General.Description
Text: <color=#E8DDD5>Nightshade is a cozy-but-feral hybrid PvPvE Rust server: PvE outside protected PvP areas, with monuments and event zones ready to bite.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Vanilla gathering on resources, components, and food</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– 10x+ stack sizes with exceptions for balance</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Monthly wipe cycle: first Thursday @ 2 PM Eastern unless Discord says otherwise</color>
<color=#ECCA97>– Monuments are always PvP. Watch the zone warnings before wandering in like loot with legs.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Custom progression through /shop, Skill Tree, quarries, events, and VIP perks</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Loot protection on earned kills, crates, drops, and event rewards</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>/rules first. /commands second. /shop when you are ready to make questionable financial choices with RP.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.ServerRules.Left
Text: <color=#D58D7C>– No raiding, damaging, griefing, laddering, walling in, trapping, or messing with player bases outside Purge or approved raid events.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– Do not block roads, monuments, caves, vendors, event areas, or another player's build.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Build for style, defense, roleplay, and deeply suspicious architecture. That part is encouraged.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– Do not steal from player containers, bodies, drops, event crates, or protected loot.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– If Loot Protection says it is not yours, it is not yours. This is not a riddle.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Team up or ask for share access when you want to split loot.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.ServerRules.Right
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>– PvP is allowed inside marked PvP monuments, PvP domes, PvP-enabled events, and during Purge.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– Outside those areas, do not attack, bait, exploit rules, or play loophole lawyer.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Watch entry/leave messages. If a dome looks spicy, assume it bites.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– No hate speech, harassment, stalking, threats, doxxing, slurs, cheating, exploiting, or ban evading.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Trash talk can be spicy. Do not make it personal, creepy, or radioactive.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Admins have final say on edge cases. If you have to say "technically," step away from the crime scene.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.ServerCommands.Left
Text: <color=#AFAFAF>Player-to-player teleport commands are not listed for next wipe.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.ServerSystems.Left
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>– RP is the main player-facing currency.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Admin Shop and Black Market systems may use special item currency when configured.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Shop stock can rotate by wipe, event, or balance pass.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Kills, crates, drops, and event rewards may lock to the player/team that earned them.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Use /share when you want another player to access protected loot.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– If a protected container says no, believe it.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.ServerSystems.Right
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>– Skill Tree unlocks long-term bonuses and progression perks.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Car chassis are buyable with RP from /shop.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Build purchased chassis at the car lift.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– VIP can use /tug for tugboat access/spawning.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– ChestStacks are available to everyone: 3 stacks for non-VIP, 5 stacks for VIP.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Use /limits to check entity limits before the server starts judging your decor choices.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.EventHelp.Left
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>– Hide and Seek runs on scheduled event days when announced.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Purge is the last 2 days of wipe: PvP, raiding, and base destruction are allowed serverwide.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>– Monuments are always PvP. Watch the zone warnings.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Heli and Bradley signals may have tiers, cooldowns, rewards, and team recommendations.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Read event warnings before throwing expensive signals like a gremlin with fireworks.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.EventHelp.Right
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>– Bradley and Heli signals are player-triggered combat events.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Raidable Bases are event bases, not normal player bases.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Read difficulty/tier info before donating your kit to the floor.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.HordesHelp.Description
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>Hordes are Defendable Homes style wave events. Build smart, check your foundations, then try not to become part of the furniture.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Your Defendable Home must be built on normal terrain using owned square or triangle foundations.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Foundations must belong to you or your team/friends/clan.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– You must be inside the Tool Cupboard area of the house when checking.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Invalid areas include monuments, cliffs, mountains, clutter/decor terrain, and bad topology.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Do not build too close to another active Defendable Homes event.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>Use /checkfoundations to check all foundations for the event.</color>
<color=#AFAFAF>⊘ = You/friends are not the foundation owner.</color>
<color=#AFAFAF>⊛ = Terrain topology is invalid. Prohibited: Cliff, Cliffside, Decor, Building, Monument, Clutter, Mountain.</color>
<color=#AFAFAF>◉ = Foundation is within 40m of a custom monument.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Bring ammo, meds, armor, and room in your inventory.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Do not drag hordes into player bases, vendors, safe builds, or random bystanders.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– PvP only applies if the event area is marked PvP or the server is in Purge.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Loot ownership follows Loot Protection and event rules.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.RaidableBases.Description
Text: <color=#E2DBD3>Raidable Bases are event bases. They are not normal player bases, and normal player bases are still protected outside Purge or approved raid events.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Do not interfere with another player's PvE raid unless event rules allow it.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– PvP raid bases, PvP domes, and Purge are different. Read the warnings.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– If you started it, finish it before the server starts spawning consequences with your name on them.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.RaidBuilderHelp.Description
Text: <color=#D58D7C>Raidbase builder access is admin-only after vetting. This is not a public toy box.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Players approved to help build/testing raidbase content.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Permissions are assigned by Admin only after vetting.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Do not share commands, bases, or access with unapproved players.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>/raidbasestart – start/setup a player raidbase build session</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>/raidreadypve – mark the saved raidbase ready for PvE use</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>/raidreadypvp – mark the saved raidbase ready for PvP use</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>/raidbaseend – end/clean up the active raidbase session</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Build clean, playable bases with accessible paths and fair loot flow.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Avoid traps that softlock players, exploit terrain, or create impossible raid paths.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Ask Admin before making major format changes. We are building content, not a lawsuit with doors.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.PvpZones.Description
Text: <color=#D58D7C>Monuments are always PvP. Watch the zone warnings before entering.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>Event domes and PvP-marked areas may also allow player combat.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Purge announcements during the last 2 days of wipe.</color>
<color=#D58D7C>When the server tells you an area is PvP, believe it. Rust loves an educational consequence.</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.VipInfo.Left
Text: <color=#E8DDD5>• Free home teleportation — no RP cost per home TP</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• Can set a home on your tugboat</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• Can use /tug for VIP tugboat access/spawning</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• Bradley signal cooldowns reduced for VIP/VIPx</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• ChestStacks: 5 stacks for VIP instead of 3</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• VIP shop perks may include claimable tool kits</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.VipInfo.Right
Text: <color=#E8DDD5>• VIP: hackable crates unlock in 2.5 minutes</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• VIPx: hackable crates unlock in 60 seconds</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• No decay on personal boats and tugboats</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• 4-module car chassis access in the RP shop</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>• Some cosmetic/building skin perks may be VIP gated</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>Higher raid tiers unlock earlier for VIP:</color>
<color=#E8DDD5>Bradley signal cooldown: 50 min VIP / 30 min VIPx</color>

UI Elements.Name: Page.VipDonation.Description
Text: <color=#E8DDD5>VIP is donation-supported, but it is not fully automatic yet.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Donate through the server store/donation link listed in Discord.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– After donating, ping/post in the donation channel.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– Include your in-game name so an admin can apply the correct role in Rust.</color>
<color=#E2DBD3>– VIP lasts until map wipe unless otherwise stated. VIPx follows the matching Discord role.</color>
<color=#AFAFAF><size=11>VIP is convenience-focused. Core content stays playable for everyone; VIP makes the gremlin treadmill faster, not mandatory.</size></color>
